questions.question: Is Flycure a hospital?
questions.answer: No, Flycure is an independent care coordination platform built by doctors to ensure ethical and transparent medical travel. We partner with accredited hospitals.

questions.question: How much does the assistance cost me?
questions.answer: Our end-to-end assistance is free for patients. Our revenue is generated directly from hospitals, not commissions on your bill, maintaining trust and clinical focus.

questions.question: What if my plans change?
questions.answer: We provide clear, legal cancellation and refund policies upfront. Your care manager will guide you through any changes to your treatment or travel schedule.

mainContent.title: About Flycure
paragraphs: Flycure was founded on a simple, yet powerful principle: healthcare should be transparent, accessible, and safe for everyone, regardless of geography. We saw a world where patients faced uncertainty, opaque pricing, and logistical nightmares when seeking medical treatment abroad. We knew there had to be a better way.

Our mission is to dismantle these barriers. We connect patients with India's top-tier, NABH-accredited hospitals and world-renowned specialists. Our unique 'Pay Hospital Directly' model ensures complete financial transparency—we never handle your money. Instead, we empower you with legally-binding agreements and fixed-price packages, eliminating hidden costs and giving you peace of mind.

We are more than a service; we are your dedicated partner. From the moment you contact us, a personal Care Manager is assigned to you, guiding you through every step of your journey. We handle the research, the vetting, the logistics, and the follow-up, so you can focus on what truly matters: your health and recovery. At Flycure, we're not just facilitating medical travel; we're building a future where world-class healthcare is within everyone's reach.

questions.question: Who prepares the legal agreement?
questions.answer: The legal agreement is prepared by the hospital's legal team and is a direct contract between you and the hospital. Flycure facilitates this process to ensure transparency and that all service terms are clearly defined and fair.

questions.question: How long does the entire process take?
questions.answer: The timeline varies depending on the treatment and visa requirements. Typically, from the first estimate to your travel date, the process can take anywhere from 2 to 6 weeks. We work to expedite this as much as possible.

questions.question: Do I pay Flycure any service charge?
questions.answer: No, you do not pay any service charge to Flycure. Our model is built on transparency, and our service fee is covered by the hospitals in our network. The price you are quoted is the price you pay directly to the hospital.
